controls.sql: SELECT v.version_id,p.perfil_id,v.configuracion_doc FROM ra_integracion_perfil_version v INNER JOIN ra_integracion_perfil p ON p.perfil_id=v.perfil_id WHERE p.ambito_ref=? AND p.activo=1 AND v.estado='PUBLICADA' AND v.version_id=? LIMIT 2
controls.requires: Exactly one publication; inspect complete recipe before accepting the proposed names. No preparation if incompatible.

controls.sql: SELECT regla_id,regla_doc FROM ra_integracion_perfil_regla WHERE version_id=? ORDER BY orden,destino_tipo,destino_ref LIMIT 101
controls.requires: Complete ordered rule set within the configured limit. Derive effective codes and stop if absence checks need revised parameters; no extra query without reviewing this budget.

controls.sql: SELECT ID_EXPEDIENTE FROM expediente_archivo WHERE ID_EMPRESA_EXPEDIENTE=? AND (CODIGO_UNICO IN (?,?) OR ALEAS_EXPEDIENTE IN (?,?) OR TEMA_EXPEDIENTE IN (?,?)) LIMIT 3
controls.requires: No rows. Reassess effective codes after reading the recipe; this lookup alone does not certify freshness.

controls.sql: SELECT plan_id FROM ra_integracion_plan WHERE ambito_ref=? AND nivel_ref=? AND (LOCATE(?,manifiesto_doc)>0 OR LOCATE(?,manifiesto_doc)>0) LIMIT 3
controls.requires: No rows; any prior plan stops the proposal without retries or effects.

controls.sql: SELECT r.raiz_id FROM ra_integracion_raiz r INNER JOIN ra_integracion_lote l ON l.lote_id=r.lote_id WHERE l.ambito_ref=? AND l.nivel_ref=? AND (LOCATE(?,r.datos_doc)>0 OR LOCATE(?,r.datos_doc)>0) LIMIT 3
SELECT id_gabinete,NOMBRE FROM system1 WHERE id_gabinete=? LIMIT 2
controls.requires: Exactly one cabinet matching the publication.

controls.sql: SELECT id_detalle_gabinete,CAMPO FROM detalle_gabienete WHERE id_gabinete=? AND VISIBLE=1 ORDER BY id_detalle_gabinete LIMIT 101
controls.requires: Recipe references must match available visible fields; no schema changes.

controls.sql: SELECT e.ID_EXPEDIENTE,e.ID_EMPRESA_EXPEDIENTE,e.GABINETE_PRODUCION,e.id_instrumento,e.CODIGO_AREA_TRD,e.CODIGO_SERIE_TRD,e.CODIGO_SUB_SERIE_TRD,r.id_registro AS relacion_id,r.ra_pro_niveles_id_nivel AS nivel_id FROM expediente_archivo e INNER JOIN ra_pro_niveles_has_expediente_archivo r ON r.expediente_archivo_ID_EXPEDIENTE=e.ID_EXPEDIENTE WHERE e.ID_EXPEDIENTE=? AND e.ID_EMPRESA_EXPEDIENTE=? AND r.ra_pro_niveles_id_nivel=? LIMIT 2
controls.requires: One known expedition/level relation; cabinet must match the inspected publication. No changes.

controls.sql: SELECT CAST(t.Id_Tipo_Doc_Series AS CHAR) AS type_id FROM tipo_doc_series t INNER JOIN expediente_archivo e ON e.id_instrumento=t.id_instrumento INNER JOIN ra_registro_instrumento_archivistico i ON i.id_instrumento=t.id_instrumento INNER JOIN registro_organigrama o ON o.ID_ORGANIGRAMA=i.registro_organigrama_ID_ORGANIGRAMA WHERE e.ID_EXPEDIENTE=? AND e.ID_EMPRESA_EXPEDIENTE=? AND o.EMPRESA_GESTION_DOCUMENTAL_ID_EMPRESA=? AND t.Estado_Tipo=1 AND i.Estado_instrumento=1 AND ((t.Series_Documentales_Id_Series=e.CODIGO_SERIE_TRD AND COALESCE(t.sub_serie_id_serie,0)=COALESCE(e.CODIGO_SUB_SERIE_TRD,0)) OR t.tipo_doc_trasversal=1) AND t.Id_Tipo_Doc_Series=? LIMIT 2
controls.requires: Exactly one active compatible typology; no permission/configuration changes.

controls.sql: SELECT n.id_nivel FROM ra_pro_niveles n INNER JOIN remit_dest_interno u ON u.id_Remit_Dest_Int=n.remit_dest_interno_id_Remit_Dest_Int WHERE n.id_nivel=? AND n.estado_nivel=1 AND u.Empresa_Gestion_Documental_id_empresa=? AND (u.id_Remit_Dest_Int=? OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ra_pro_permisos_niveles p WHERE p.ra_pro_niveles_id_nivel=n.id_nivel AND p.remit_dest_interno_id_Remit_Dest_Int=? AND p.estado_permiso=1 AND p.carga_archivo=1)) LIMIT 2
controls.requires: Read-only authority hint; actual application session and legacy authority must still be proved before effects.

controls.sql: SELECT intento_id,lote_id,estado,fase,evidencia_doc,fin_utc FROM ra_integracion_intento WHERE (lote_id=? AND intento_id=?) OR (lote_id=? AND intento_id IN (?,?)) ORDER BY intento_id LIMIT 4
controls.requires: Observe 41 and 53 EN_CURSO, 52 CONFIRMADO with known IDs; no replay/reconcile/repair.

controls.sql: SELECT ID_REGISTRO_PRODUCION_DOCUMENTAL FROM registro_producion_documental WHERE ID_EMPRESA_DOCUMENTO=? AND EXPEDIENTE_ARCHIVO_ID_EXPEDIENTE=? AND SEGUNDO_NOMBRE_DOCUMENTO=? LIMIT 2
controls.requires: No prior document with the exact individual filename.

outputPolicy: Only counts, numeric known references, booleans and hashes. No rows, credentials, cookies, operation keys or connection strings.
